title: Knowlify vs NewForm: AI Video Batches or Creator-Led Production?
summary: Knowlify vs NewForm for Meta video: finished AI ads from Knowlify, or NewForm's strategy, creator-led production and testing software. Compare scope and media.
body_markdown:
## Which other creator-led providers should you compare?


Creator-led production has more providers than the AI route, so compare a few before you choose.[The UGC Agency](https://theugc.agency/) is a London-based company that handles scripts, casting, edits, usage rights and creator payments, with a network of more than 30,000 creators. It targets 21 days for the first round of finished ads, and it does not run media.[Hiring UGC creators versus a UGC ad service](https://knowlify.com/articles/hire-ugc-creators-vs-ugc-ad-service) walks through the trade-offs.


[inBeat](https://inbeat.agency/paid-social-agency) typically plans 8 to 15 new concepts a month for creator-made assets across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and other paid social platforms. Its pricing is not published.[Gate Studios](https://www.dont-gate.com/services/ugc-agency) describes up to 12,000 or more creator-filmed assets a month across all clients, scopes each brand's volume from spend and testing cadence, and publishes no price.


## What Meta rules apply to creator-led ads?


Meta's[developer documentation on partnership ads](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/ads-commerce/marketing-api/ad-creative/partnership-ads/ads-creation) says partnership ads show the brand and partner accounts in the header, and the creator must grant permission or Meta holds the ad in a pending delivery state. Creator-led formats raise the same permission question. Ask who holds each creator's permission, for how long, and what happens if it is withdrawn. Also confirm that the usage rights in the scope cover paid use on Meta.


Meta's[video ad guide](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide/video) recommends a 4:5 ratio for Facebook Feed at 1440 x 1800 pixels, and its[aspect ratio guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/103816146375741) recommends 9:16 for full-screen vertical placements. Ask for both masters on every creator-led batch, and check each cut in the placement preview before approval.


AI labels matter if any part of your creative uses AI-generated people. Meta's[AI transparency update](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/gen-ai-transparency-metas-ads-products/) says it labels ads created or significantly edited with its own generative AI features, and that a photorealistic AI-generated person gets the label next to the Sponsored label. Plan that disclosure before you script.


Ask NewForm whether media buying is in the scope, which concepts and variations are included, who owns the usage rights and for how long, and how many rounds of revision you get. Put the answers in the proposal before kickoff.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for finished AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, with about 25 finished ads a week and a person checking every ad.
- NewForm fits brands that want creative strategy, creator-led production and a testing tool, with media buying only when it is in scope.
- Knowlify does not supply real human creators, so choose a creator-led provider when a real person must appear on camera.
- Both quote privately, so compare the same deliverables, rights and media responsibilities.
- Confirm creator permissions and usage rights in writing before any partnership ad runs.


## FAQ


### What is the best option for Meta video ads?


Knowlify is our top pick for finished AI video ads on Facebook and Instagram, with optional Meta campaign management. NewForm is the better choice when you want human strategists and creators leading the work, plus a testing tool. Choose by production model first, then compare quotes for the same deliverables.


### Does NewForm buy media?


Only when media buying is written into the agreed scope. NewForm's full-service page says media buying is included only when specified for the engagement. Confirm that line before you compare quotes, because a creative quote may not include media.


### Can Knowlify make ads with real creators?


No. Its UGC format uses AI presenters, so a brief that needs a real customer on camera belongs with a creator-led provider such as NewForm.


### What should I ask NewForm before signing?


Ask which concepts and variations are included, what usage rights you receive and for how long, whether media buying is in scope, and how many rounds of revision are included. NewForm agrees these items before kickoff, so get the answers in the proposal.


### Do partnership ads need the creator's permission?


Yes. Meta's documentation says the creator must grant permission, or the ad is held in a pending delivery state. Ask who manages that permission and what happens if the creator withdraws it.
